response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count_above_average_types, AVG(c.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM c CROSS JOIN a WHERE c.cnt > a.avg_cnt

assumptions.assumption: orders.recordvault is unique per order, as the documentation says, so each risk/margin record matches at most one order and the inner join does not duplicate records.
Orders with a NULL ordertune, if any, form their own group and count as a type in the average across types.
The average across types is the unweighted mean of the per-type counts, not the mean per record.
